instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Digital lending platform offering point-of-sale consumer financing and SME working capital loans through an API-integrated credit decisioning engine. Underwritten €120M in loans across 40 merchant partners, Ember operates within a complex regulatory landscape requiring ongoing compliance with fair lending acts and data privacy standards.
answers.pastInitiatives: Innovation is embedded in our operating rhythm. We run quarterly hackathons focusing on API integration efficiencies, maintain a formal patent portfolio for proprietary risk modeling techniques, and have a rotating 'innovation fellow' program where high-potential employees spend 6 months dedicated to exploratory projects. Our last hackathon successfully produced a prototype for automated quality inspection using computer vision that is now in production, reducing defect escape rate by 35%.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base—our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.
answers.additionalContext: The rise of specialized fintech competitors like Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) and embedded finance providers requires constant product innovation to maintain market share. Furthermore, navigating evolving GDPR requirements for cross-border data usage adds significant technical complexity.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

opportunities.title: Enhancing API Decisioning Velocity
opportunities.rationale: As a core competency, optimizing the speed and accuracy of our credit decisioning engine will reduce operational costs and improve customer experience metrics. This is a low-risk path that immediately addresses performance bottlenecks.

first_actions: Conduct a full audit of API latency across all core lending products.
Allocate 5% of the budget to dedicated cloud infrastructure optimization review.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average loan approval processing time by 15% within Q3.
milestones: Q2 End: Latency baseline established and prioritized gaps identified.
Q3 End: Automated optimization implemented; latency reduced.

opportunities.title: Cross-Sell Ancillary Services for SME Clients
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging our existing customer base, we can introduce complementary services like specialized treasury management tools or tax advisory integration. This expands revenue per user without requiring entirely new regulatory products.

first_actions: Identify 5 high-value SME clients for service mapping.
Develop a white-label integration plan for one ancillary financial tool.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase average client revenue per account by 10% within the fiscal year.
milestones: Q3 End: Pilot program successfully launched with 5 clients.
Q4 End: Service integrated into core platform offering.

opportunities.title: Launch a B2B Embedded Finance Micro-API Suite
opportunities.rationale: To achieve true diversification, Ember should move beyond consumer lending by packaging its credit decisioning engine into a white-label API product for other Fintechs. This creates a new revenue stream based on data licensing and platform fees.

first_actions: Conduct market research defining the ideal B2B API feature set (KYC/Credit Scoring).
Form an internal 'Platform Strategy' task force.
resources_needed: Contract with a specialized legal counsel (€15,000)
Dedicated product manager allocation (1 FTE equivalent)
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 3 paying B2B API partners within 18 months.
milestones: Q1 End: MVP of the B2B API documentation released.
Q4 End: First revenue generated from B2B licensing fees.

next_steps.action: Establish a dedicated 'Product Diversification' charter and appoint an interim Product Owner.
Initiate discovery phase for the B2B Embedded Finance API opportunity to validate market fit and technical feasibility.
Develop and implement a formal internal 'Innovation Culture' workshop focusing on knowledge sharing and risk-taking within the current team structure.

key_weaknesses: Lack of dedicated R&D headcount, leading to reactive rather than proactive technological investment cycles.
High reliance on 'owner_alone' decision-making, which creates bottlenecks and slows down necessary radical experimentation.
Limited team expertise; the lack of specialized in-house talent makes deep technical diversification efforts reliant on expensive external advisory support.
Weak internal culture around risk tolerance, making it difficult for the micro-company to pursue high-impact but uncertain initiatives like B2B expansion.
